# Pak Termite & Pest Control

> Pak Termite & Pest Control is a premier professional pest control, fumigation, structural maintenance, and waterproofing service provider operating across Rawalpindi and Islamabad, Pakistan. Founded by CEO Muhammad Riaz, the business specializes in safe, government-approved solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial properties.

## Core Services
- **Termite Treatment:** Pre-construction and post-construction anti-termite proofing with written service warranties.
- **General Pest Control:** Comprehensive eradication of cockroaches, bed bugs, ants, mosquitoes, and rodents.
- **Commercial & Industrial Fumigation:** Large-scale sanitization and pest management for offices, warehouses, and housing societies.
- **Waterproofing & Heatproofing:** Advanced roof insulation and structural leakage prevention treatments.
- **Water Tank Cleaning:** Hygienic cleaning and disinfection of underground and overhead water storage tanks.
